scope: Synchronous filesystem cache update suppression and failure atomicity; SDK publication/ACK/durability ordering retained.

change.known_successful_cache: flag established only from valid JSON or a completed persist operation
change.same_value_skip: full PersistentVariables equality, not just flight_state
change.changed_values: write/rename first; publish in-memory values and success flag only after completion
change.local_setters: underglow, buzzer, flight-state and DAQ clock use same transactional helper; SDK set_network_variable still called on every successful request, including equal values
change.startup_missing_file: existing explicit initialization persist preserved; first equal incoming default also writes when no successful cache exists
not_added: callback blocking beyond existing changed-value filesystem persistence

proof.unchanged_durable_zero_write: SDK callback succeeds with json.tmp deliberately a directory, which makes any write attempt fail; valid tagged JSON remains byte-identical
proof.failed_changed_value: SDK error retained, RAM and original file stay at1, fresh-packet same incoming value2 succeeds after IO recovery
proof.first_missing_equal_default: actual read-only SDK callback creates cache even when incoming state equals in-memory default
proof.other_fields: underglow, buzzer, DAQ clock and session remain atomic and retained across failed full-snapshot commit
proof.local_network_publication: two equal state commands still emit two distinct packet IDs and nondecreasing source timestamps

audit.changed_value_latency: Still performs synchronous serialization/write/rename under STORE mutex before SDK return; unchanged values remove that work only after prior successful cache.
audit.filesystem_failure: No RAM publication on write or rename error; same-value retry remains eligible.
audit.SDK_admission_failure: Existing write-before-SDK semantics retained: durable local intent can precede failed network admission, and equal-value republish remains allowed.
audit.toggle_read_then_set: Existing separate read/set locking retained; no new concurrency/transaction guarantee for simultaneous toggles.

measurement_limit: Microsecond timings are local Linux/tmp observations, not Pi SD or physical RF latency measurements. No image or MCU configuration changed by these tests.
immutable_context: bc6 Docker build/image context retained unchanged; final combined4profile+simulation owned by root.
